objective: Adrian signs the emergency-intervention authorization, completing his enrollment in the experimental-medicine program and securing his financial lifeline, while confronting the final bureaucratic hurdle of the trial.
intendedChange: Adrian signs the emergency-intervention authorization, completing his enrollment in the experimental-medicine program and securing his financial lifeline, while confronting the final bureaucratic hurdle of the trial.
prohibitedPatterns: Do not depict Adrian signing the authorization or handing the document to Dr. Thorne in any scene prior to the final scene of the chapter.
Do not introduce a new medical emergency, accident, or physical collapse that interrupts the administrative process.
Do not have Dr. Thorne offer emotional support, financial advice, or break clinical boundaries to comfort Adrian.
Do not resolve the mystery of the medication's side effects or reveal the existence of nanites.
Do not introduce Lena Reyes or any new romantic/sexual interest.

scenes.purpose: Adrian arrives at the clinic in a state of physical exhaustion and cognitive fog from the medication's side effects, navigating the intake process while suppressing his symptoms to avoid disqualification.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian is seated in Room 4 with Dr. Thorne, having passed the initial check-in, but his physical instability (tremors, blurred vision) is actively threatening his ability to read and process the upcoming documents.

scenes.purpose: Dr. Thorne presents the Emergency Intervention Authorization (EIA) as a mandatory final step for full enrollment, explaining the legal implications of surrendering bodily autonomy in a medical emergency without offering reassurance.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian has read the EIA document and understands that signing it grants the hospital unrestricted access to his body and medical history in a crisis, creating a moment of high-stakes decision-making where he must weigh his financial survival against his personal autonomy.

scenes.purpose: Adrian makes the final choice to sign the EIA, demonstrating his complete commitment to the trial and his willingness to commodify his body for survival, thereby securing his enrollment and financial lifeline.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian signs the Emergency Intervention Authorization and hands the document to Dr. Thorne, completing his enrollment in the experimental-medicine program and securing his financial lifeline, while confronting the final cost of his participation.
